C1798.title: Man Lured by “30% Off Loan Repayment” Sentenced for Laundering Telecom Fraud Proceeds
keywords: aiding and abetting information network crime
C1798.summary: Wu, knowing the repayment funds were linked to telecom network crimes, actively provided his personal online loan account to receive and transfer illicit proceeds, illegally profiting over RMB 10,000 through a “30% off loan repayment” scheme. In June 2026, Beijing Fengtai Court found his conduct constituted the crime of aiding and abetting information network crime and rendered a criminal judgment considering his truthful confession and other circumstances.
